bootstrap_method: Nonparametric percentile bootstrap of seed units using common multinomial resamples; individual attempts are never resampled.
credit_scheme: All three selected turns updated only after attempt completion, each with sample_weight=1/3; total attempt weight=1.
descriptive_effect_band_definition: Absolute relative reduction magnitude: <2% negligible, 2%-<5% small, 5%-10% moderate, >10% large; descriptive only.

environments.E0_NO_CONTEXT: Arm identity only; all observed state is irrelevant.
environments.E1_MD6: Arm identity and current MD6 probability state only.
environments.E2_MASTERY: Arm identity, current MD6 state, and mastery_before.
environments.E3_QUALITY: Arm identity, current MD6 state, and prior-turn running MRB1 quality.
environments.E4_MIXED: Arm identity, current MD6 state, mastery_before, and prior-turn running MRB1 quality, with weak sparse interactions.

hidden_utility_generator.e4_non_circularity: Bounded arm-specific parameters, sparse zero coefficients, tanh nonlinearity, and weak mastery/quality interactions; parameters are generated before policy outcomes.
hidden_utility_generator.sparsity: Deterministic seed-index masks set selected mastery, quality, and interaction coefficients to zero.

multiple_comparison_correction: Holm correction across the eight pre-specified comparisons within each checkpoint; attempt 500 is the primary endpoint.
optimal_arm_indicator_definition: 1 when selected arm equals the deterministic eligible oracle arm.
oracle_definition: Deterministic canonical-order argmax of hidden expected utility over the current canonical eligible-arm set only.
paired_improvement_definition: cumulative_regret_simpler - cumulative_regret_richer; positive means lower observed regret for the richer representation.
permutation_method: Two-sided Monte Carlo paired sign-flip test of the mean seed-level cumulative-regret difference; +1 correction.
relative_regret_reduction_definition: mean_paired_improvement / simpler_mean_regret; stored as a fraction.

rng_strategy.coefficient_stream: Independent per environment and numerical seed.
rng_strategy.construction: NumPy SeedSequence with explicit stream components.
rng_strategy.exogenous_streams: Independent spawned MD6, mastery, MRB1 attempt, MRB1 turn, and evaluator streams, shared exactly across C0-C4.
rng_strategy.policy_streams: Independent deterministic LinTS stream per environment, seed, and context condition; posterior sampling advances once per turn.

sanity_checks.check: MRB1 excluded from E0/E1/E2 hidden utility
mastery excluded from E0/E1/E3 hidden utility
multiple arms can be oracle-optimal across generated states
no current-turn MRB1 leakage and running arithmetic means
no LinTS update before attempt completion
MD6, MRB1, and mastery state bounds

state_generators.evaluator: Three shared independent Uniform(0,1) draws; score=sum(U<p_policy), which is Binomial(n=3,p=p_policy).
state_generators.mrb1: clip(0.64*attempt Beta(2.4,2.2) + 0.36*turn Beta(2,2) + fixed task offset, 0, 1); observed only after response.
